resources.string: Sampling; saving authorized assets and aggregates only
Demo data · not a field measurement
APs and broadcast addresses are not people. RF records contain zone and time aggregates only; field calibration is pending.
Create a cinema and zone to start your first inspection.
Scanning requires location and nearby-device permissions, with system location, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth enabled. Data stays on this device.
Scanning permissions are incomplete. Allow precise location and nearby devices in system settings.
Enable system location to receive valid Wi-Fi scans.
Scanning could not start. Check permissions, location and radios.
Unregistered signals are displayed in memory for this session only and cleared when sampling ends.
Start sampling to see signals here.
This asset is owned by the cinema or authorized for management
This radio address is a matching clue, not the physical asset identity. Register again if its address changes.
This signal is already bound to an asset. Delete the original registration first.
During sampling, select a cinema device from visible signals to register it. A vendor label alone does not establish ownership.
This removes the binding and inspection history for this asset.
Move slowly within the registered zone and watch relative signal changes. Values are not distances.
At least 3 valid inspections establish a baseline. An asset is flagged missing only after 2 consecutive valid inspections without a sighting.
Your first record starts with an inspection.
Both radio sources received; field calibration still required
RF records save zone, time and aggregates only. Unauthorized MACs, names and raw payloads are excluded from the database and exports. No cross-day customer identification.
